integrity: Proof and finite exact verifier included. Originality compared against direct source and general matrix literature. Self-review only; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the specified binary Toeplitz recursion with every q_k at least four; assumes standard Toeplitz odometer factor and minimality criterion, both cited. No result for arbitrary Toeplitz lifts or spectral properties. Novelty may be an implicit specialization of general Bratteli theory.
title: A sharp invariant-measure dichotomy for binary lifts of regular Toeplitz words
